description: Intelligent tool recommendation system for Synergy Dashboard - helps AI agents select the right tool based on their current situation with complete usage instructions

tools.name: synergy_recommend_next_tool
tools.description: Get intelligent, personalized recommendation for which Synergy tool to use next based on your current situation. Returns complete instructions including: which tool to call, why it's appropriate, all parameters with examples, working code, next steps after success, and critical warnings. USE THIS when you're unsure which Synergy tool to use or how to proceed. This is your GPS for navigating Synergy workflows.

when_to_use: First time using Synergy and need to know where to start
Created resources but unsure how to update Synergy
Have session_id but don't know which tool to call next
Want to move card or check status but need guidance
Something went wrong and need troubleshooting direction
Unsure about parameter requirements or usage patterns
benefits: Eliminates guesswork - tells you exactly what to do
Shows critical warnings to avoid data loss
Gives clear next steps after tool succeeds
workflow_pattern: Execute the recommended tool with example as guide
Call synergy_recommend_next_tool() again for next phase

current_situation.description:
Your current state in the Synergy workflow:

- 'just_starting': First time using Synergy, need to create project. Use when user asks to build multi-platform system and you haven't created Synergy session yet.

- 'project_created': Created Synergy project, have session_id, just created FIRST resource. Use when you called synergy_smart_project_tracker() and now need to add first document.

- 'adding_resources': Adding MORE resources to existing project. Use when you've already updated Synergy with 1+ resources and need to add another.

- 'need_to_update': Have session_id and resources, need to update Synergy but unsure how. Use when you have documents/links to add but haven't started the update process.

- 'moving_card': Want to change Kanban column (backlog/in_progress/review/done). Use when project phase changes.

- 'checking_status': Want to see current state of project. Use when user asks 'what's the status?' or you need current information.

- 'listing_projects': Want to see all Synergy projects or filter by criteria. Use when user asks 'what projects do I have?' or need to find a project.

- 'troubleshooting': Something went wrong (documents disappeared, errors, data loss). Use when you encounter errors or unexpected behavior.

- 'learning': Need to understand Synergy concepts, patterns, best practices. Use when you're new to Synergy or need to understand specific aspects.

have_session_id.description: Do you have a session_id saved from previous synergy_smart_project_tracker() or synergy_create_session() call? True if you have it, False if you don't. CRITICAL: If you lost session_id, set to False and use 'listing_projects' situation to find it.

resources_created.description: How many resources (docs, sheets, forms, emails) have you created so far for this project? 0 = none yet, 1-2 = some, 3+ = multiple. Used to provide context-appropriate guidance. If you've created resources but haven't updated Synergy yet, count them here.

task_type.description:
Optional: What kind of project are you building? Helps tailor recommendations.

- 'multi_platform': Using 3+ different platforms (gmail + sheets + forms + docs)
- 'automation': Building automated workflow or system
- 'data_pipeline': Data collection, processing, or analysis system
- 'customer_system': Customer-facing system (forms, emails, tracking)
- 'internal_tool': Internal business tool or process

returns.description: Complete recommendation package with tool name, reason, parameters with examples, working code, next steps, warnings, and schemas to fetch

critical_notes: ALWAYS call this tool when unsure about next Synergy step
Provides complete working code - no guesswork needed
Shows warnings to prevent data loss from wrong patterns
Can be called multiple times as you progress through workflow
Each recommendation includes 'next_steps' to guide continuous progress
If recommendation says 'fetch first', you MUST do it to prevent data loss
